title: Stone Pickaxe
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: Removed early on in development

Description

Wooden Pickaxe was a pickaxe that new players were supposed to recieve at the start of the game. It was supposed to be worst pickaxe in the game, being also sold at The Oak Depot.

This pickaxe was removed very early on in development due to being unneeded, as it barely had any significant stat differences compared to the Rusty Pickaxe.

Appearance

Wooden pickaxe is a short sized pick, sharing it's model with Rusty Pickaxe. It's headpiece is made out of gray wood, using the default legacy wood material. It's handle is covered in black bandages acting as an improvised grip, while being made out of typical dark brown wood, using the default legacy wood material.

Trivia

  • This tool is a part of the group of removed starter tools. Those being the Wooden Axe, Wooden Chisel and Wooden Saw
  • Unlike looking like it was made out of stone, it's actually wooden. Early model of it looked entirely wooden.
